notes.title: Slum Ball Full Version finally available
notes.content:
Dear VR fans!

The full version of Slum Ball is out!  We put our hearts and souls into this game to make it as fun as possible. U24 team hopes that you like what we have come up with.

Enjoy! :)

notes.title: Full version coming soon!
notes.content:
We will be releasing the full version of Slum Ball 

Features include:

- world's 1st photorealistic level in a game
- awesome tournaments
- more fun and physical activity

Our tournament is on hold for now but we will be back soon with a better game!

We appreciate all the positive feedback and we are working towards bringing you a better experience.

notes.title: First online tournament
notes.content:
We are excited to bring to you our innovative VR game and tournament that will enable you to win real prizes every week. The first of its kind, our tournament welcomes free participation from all interested VR gamers all across the world.

The first online tournament ends on May 20th, +2 GMT. Winners will be announced on our website and Facebook page.

notes.title: Live Tournament in Estonia
notes.content:
Our first Live Tournament is taking place in Tallinn, Estonia at PlayFair. 

All EXPO visitors have the chance to test out their skills on Slum Ball VR game, where your goal is to get the highest score! These amazing awards are waiting for the best: 

1st place - TV JVC 43" FullHD LED LCD
2nd place - LG 24’’ monitor
3rd place - Huawei Y6 Dual-SIM smartphone
